title: Exact counterexample variance ratio
statement: For the specified function $F$ on the three-dimensional sign cube and its specified randomized decision tree $T$, let $\\operatorname{Var}(F)$ be the variance under the uniform sign distribution, let $\\operatorname{Inf}_i(F)$ be the squared $L^2$ norm of the coordinate-$i$ product Laplacian, and let $q_i$ be the probability that $T$ queries coordinate $i$ on a uniformly random input. Then $\\operatorname{Var}(F)/(\\sum_{i=0}^2 q_i\\operatorname{Inf}_i(F))=(130+20\\sqrt3)/157$.
caveat: The supplied formal statement refers to the counterexample function and randomized decision tree by name but does not include the definition of the tree, so their specifications cannot be stated self-containedly from this payload.
